source.scope: store-wide (NOT product-scoped) — an order belongs to Meta if its first-session utm_campaign is one of "Sales Ads – Copy" / "Sales Ads" / "Sales Ads | Retargeting | Add to Cart" / "New Sales ad set" / "ABO Sales Ads - Retarget - Catalog Ads" / "ABO Sales Ads - Lookalike - Catalog Ads", OR first-session source is "Facebook" / "Instagram" / "android-app://m.facebook.com/", OR first-session channel is Social with source "an unknown source" (case-insensitive). Checked only after DM-Ad — an order already claimed by DM-Ad never lands here.. Order-level rows (no per-product breakdown) with full session history. Groups are checked in a fixed priority order (DM-Ad -> Meta -> Sonya -> Sajeepan -> Sukirtha -> Organic -> CPPC -> Thishoban) so no order can appear in more than one group's tab. Standalone page, built 2026-07-27.
